notes: The 8 ohm speaker is modelled with the catalogue 'buzzer' type (ports 1, 2) because the image shows a small speaker with two leads; port 1 is the red lead, port 2 the black lead.
The speaker's black lead plugs directly into the Uno GND header socket beside AREF (modelled as GND.3); no separate jumper wire.
The series resistor is 100 ohm in the text and hardware list, but the schematic labels it 10K. I followed the text (100 ohm).

Breadboard columns were estimated from the image: speaker lead, resistor and pin-9 wire in column 9 (top and bottom banks). Photoresistor, 5V wire and A0 wire at column 21. 4.7K resistor from column 21 to column 24 (bottom bank), with the GND wire at column 24. Rows within a strip are arbitrary.
The Uno's power-header GND is modelled as GND.1.
